title: BeadGridStudioPalette
description: JSON Schema for Bead Grid Studio open palette definitions.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the palette schema format.

id.description: Unique identifier for the palette provider.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the palette.

source.description: Data provenance, license, or origin repository/link.

license.description: License under which the color mapping data is published (e.g. MIT, CC0-1.0, Apache-2.0).

beadMm.description: Nominal bead outer diameter in millimeters (e.g. 2.6 for mini beads, 5.0 for midi beads).

anchors.description: Semantic anchor color codes used for background, outlines, and highlights.

colors.description: Ordered list of color definitions in this palette.

code.description: Unique alphanumeric code for this color (e.g. 'A1', 'H7', '01').

name.description: Localized or descriptive name of the color.

displayHex.description: Optional on-screen display hex override for near-white or metallic beads.

series.description: Optional classification series (e.g. 'A' for yellows, 'H' for neutrals).

isTransparent.description: True if this bead represents clear / transparent material excluded from automatic color matching.
